periods.description: Post-imperial kingdom entering reconstruction after Fugil's defeat and Rofi's death. Lux becomes provisional king for one year while the country prepares to move away from ruin dependency and toward stable governance.
periods.history: Rofi's death and the final battle create a succession crisis resolved by Lux's provisional kingship and five marriages.
periods.goals: Maintain peace, rebuild without abusing ruins, manage diplomacy, and stabilize succession.
periods.structure: Formal monarchy in transition; Lux as king, Lisha and other queens as consorts, Dist handling much internal administration.
